notes: PerkToken (src/PerkToken.sol) is a plain, fixed-supply OpenZeppelin v5.1.0 ERC-20: name Perkshire IMDway, symbol PERK, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 PERK (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which on the launch is the ProjectFactory. No further mint path exists, so totalSupply can never grow. There is no owner, role, pause, blocklist, freeze, seize, burnFrom, fee, tax or burn on transfer, so no launch address needs exempting and the token takes none of $factory, $poolManager or $launchNumber. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT and makes no external calls. The launch deploys no application contracts: contracts is empty, and the DeployPerkToken script in script/ is a local-network convenience the launch does not use. The factory pays the supply out: the swarm's share to the launch's MerkleDistributor, 80% as single-sided liquidity in the PERK/IMD Uniswap v4 pool opened at a 2,500 IMD market cap for the whole supply, and the remainder to 0x206f5dbf4f135c6183b5a5b99327fa0be34cb4d9. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
